crossRefs.note: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

translations.web: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
translations.bsb: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
translations.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
translations.asv: The disciples therefore said unto him, Lord, if he is fallen asleep, he will recover.
